label: copy-phase input v (later copy positions)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, nearly always when the fed-back input token is v (95% of activation mass; small remainder on copy-phase u and g), and only at recall_idx >= 3 (never in the original or delimiter phase, never on first occurrences). Rate rises with position: highest at the last steps of long (L=9) sequences. It is very selective though: only ~12% of copy-phase v inputs at recall_idx>=3 activate. Activation is more likely when the next output after v is g/u/b/j/3 (adding that raises precision to 0.36 but drops recall to 0.48), and the strongest examples often have h just before v, but no simple token condition separates active from inactive v steps. Does not fire on v in the original phase.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=13: v, u, g, b; t=12: v, u, g; t=17: v, u, g, b) and the token being output (most: g, u, b, j, 3, v; least: k, 1, m, d); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=4, t=17, recall_idx=8.
